info.name: Snoopy Roblox Theme
info.description:
A cozy autumn Snoopy theme for Roblox :)
This style adds a warm fall background featuring Snoopy and Woodstock sitting under a colorful tree. The page gets a soft, peaceful autumn vibe with gentle falling leaves and a relaxing seasonal atmosphere. Perfect for anyone who loves Snoopy, fall colors, and cute aesthetic themes.
